title: Landa Amavidiyo e-TikTok Ngaphandle Kwe-Watermark (Mahhala)
description: Umhlahlandlela ophelele wokulanda amavidiyo e-TikTok ngaphandle kwe-watermark efonini naku-laptop. Mahhala, akudingi app noma ukungena ngemvume.
body:
Ufuna ukulondoloza ividiyo ye-TikTok oyithandayo kodwa awufuni ilogo negama le-akhawunti kunamathele esikrinini? Ungalanda amavidiyo e-TikTok ngaphandle kwe-watermark (uphawu lwamanzi) ngendlela elula kakhulu: kopisha ilinki yevidiyo, uyinamathisele ku-I Need Save, bese ukhetha ikhwalithi oyifunayo. Akudingeki ufake i-app eyengeziwe, akudingeki ungene ngemvume, futhi kumahhala.

Kulo mhlahlandlela uzofunda zonke izinyathelo, indlela yokukhetha inketho efanele, kanye nesixazululo uma ividiyo ingakaveli ku-gallery.

Kungani Ukhetha Amavidiyo e-TikTok Ngaphandle Kwe-Watermark?

Uma ulondoloza ividiyo ngenkinobho ye-TikTok uqobo, imiphumela ivamise ukuba ne-watermark eyilogo negama lomsebenzisi. Ukuze uyibuke wena kungase kungabi yinkinga, kodwa i-watermark ingavala izingxenye ezibalulekile zevidiyo, isibonelo umbhalo weresiphi, izinyathelo zesifundo, noma amagama engoma.

Inguqulo engenayo i-watermark ibukeka ihlanzekile futhi kumnandi ukuyibuka kaningi. Yingakho i-I Need Save incamela inguqulo engenayo i-watermark uma itholakala kuvidiyo oyinamathiselayo.

Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo e-TikTok Ngaphandle Kwe-Watermark Efonini

Ungenza lezi zinyathelo ku-Android noma ku-iPhone. Qiniseka ukuthi ividiyo ivela ku-akhawunti esesidlangalaleni.

  1. Vula i-app ye-TikTok bese ufuna ividiyo ofuna ukuyilondoloza.
  2. Thepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana (Share) kuleyo vidiyo.
  3. Khetha Kopisha ilinki (Copy link). Ilinki yevidiyo manje isebhodini lokunamathisela.
  4. Vula i-browser, bese uvakashela i-ineedsave.com.
  5. Namathisela ilinki ebhokisini elikhona, noma vele uthephe inkinobho ethi Namathisela.
  6. Cindezela okuthi Landa bese ulinda kancane kuze kuvele izinketho zamafayela.
  7. Khetha inketho yevidiyo oyifunayo. Ifayela lizolanda ngqo kudivayisi yakho.

Uma inkinobho iguquka okwesikhashana ithi Iyalungisa…, ungethuki. Amanye amavidiyo adinga ukucutshungulwa kuqala, isibonelo ividiyo nomsindo wayo kuyahlanganiswa. Ukulanda kuzoqala ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ifayela selilungile.

Indlela Yokulanda ku-Laptop Noma Kukhompyutha

Indlela icishe ifane. Vula i-TikTok ku-browser yekhompyutha, khetha ividiyo oyifunayo, bese ukopisha ilinki yayo kumenyu ethi Yabelana noma ku-address bar. Bese uvula ikhasi lokulanda, namathisela ilinki, chofoza okuthi Landa, bese ukhetha ikhwalithi. Ifayela lizongena kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe) kukhompyutha yakho.

Ukuqonda Izinketho Ezivelayo

Ngemuva kokucindezela okuthi Landa, uzobona izinketho ezimbalwa. Nansi incazelo emfushane:

  • Ividiyo ngamakhwalithi ahlukene, isibonelo 360p, 720p, noma 1080p, kuye ngevidiyo yangempela. Lapho inombolo iphakeme khona, isithombe sicaca kakhulu, kodwa nefayela liba likhulu.
  • Uphawu lwamanzi: izinketho ezisenayo i-watermark zibhalwe leli gama. Uma ufuna ividiyo ehlanzekile, khetha inketho yevidiyo engabhalwanga ukuthi Uphawu lwamanzi.
  • Umsindo: ungathatha izwi lodwa, kungaba ngekhwalithi yangempela noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe evidiyweni.
  • Isithombe / Isithonjana: isithombe sekhava sevidiyo leyo.

Udidekile ngokukhetha i-resolution? Funda nendatshana ethi umehluko wekhwalithi yevidiyo engu-360p, 720p, ne-1080p ukuze ukhethe ngokuya ngesikrini sakho nendawo yokugcina esele efonini.

Ithiphu: Amanye amavidiyo e-TikTok asebenzisa i-codec ye-HEVC (H.265). Amafoni amadala kakhulu kwesinye isikhathi akakwazi ukuwadlala kahle. Uma kukhona inketho ye-H.264, yikhethe ngoba idlala kuwo wonke amadivayisi.

Ikuphi Ividiyo Esilandiwe?

Indawo yefayela incike kudivayisi oyisebenzisayo:

  • I-Android: ividiyo ilondolozwa kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). I-app ye-Gallery kwesinye isikhathi idinga isikhashana ngaphambi kokuyibonisa.
  • I-iPhone/iPad (Safari): ividiyo ingena ku-app ethi Files, kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). Ukuze ivele ku-app ethi Photos, vula ividiyo ku-Files, thepha okuthi Share (Yabelana), bese ukhetha Save Video (Londoloza Ividiyo).

Amafayela e-MP4 alandiwe anobude besikhathi obulungile futhi adlala kuma-app e-gallery njengamavidiyo ajwayelekile. Kufanele wazi futhi ukuthi amafayela adluliswa ngqo esuka ku-TikTok aye kudivayisi yakho futhi awagcinwa kuseva ye-I Need Save.

Kungani Ividiyo Yehluleka Ukulanda?

Kunezimo ezimbalwa ezenza ividiyo ingakwazi ukuthathwa:

  • Ividiyo ivela ku-akhawunti eyimfihlo.
  • Okuqukethwe kubonakala kuphela ngemuva kokungena ngemvume.
  • Ividiyo ikhawulelwe ezifundeni ezithile.
  • Ilinki enamathiselwe ayiphelele noma ikopishwe kabi.

Esimweni sokugcina, zama ukukopisha futhi ilinki ngqo enkinobhweni ethi Yabelana, bese uphinda inqubo kusukela ekuqaleni.

Kusebenzise Ngobuhlakani

Landa amavidiyo ukuze uwasebenzise wena kuphela. Hlonipha amalungelo obunikazi abadali: qala ucele imvume ngaphambi kokuphinda uthumele futhi uhlale ubalula umnikazi wangempela. Ngale ndlela, usengakujabulela okuqukethwe okuthandayo ngaphandle kokulimaza abakwenzile.

Imibuzo Evame Ukubuzwa

Ingabe i-I Need Save imahhala?

Yebo, imahhala. Akudingeki futhi ufake i-app noma uvule i-akhawunti. Vele uvule isayithi ku-browser.

Ingabe wonke amavidiyo e-TikTok atholakala ngaphandle kwe-watermark?

Inguqulo engenayo i-watermark ihlala incanyelwa uma itholakala. Uma kuvidiyo ethile kuvela kuphela izinketho ezibhalwe ukuthi Uphawu lwamanzi, usengayilanda leyo nguqulo.

Ngingathatha izwi lodwa?

Yebo. Khetha inketho ethi Umsindo, kungaba ngekhwalithi yangempela noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps. Awudingi i-app yokuguqula ehlukile. Umhlahlandlela ophelele usendatshaneni ethi indlela yokuguqula ividiyo ibe yi-MP3.
